authority.evaluation: Same frozen v1 deterministic 64-case protocols; diagnostic/selection, not untouched tests or match win rates
authority.optimizer: Same parent Adam, counters and RNG in both arms; no reset of moments
authority.parent_campaign: Agent-requested pause, not abandoned user goal. Original STOP remains to prevent accidental concurrent resume.
authority.resume: Same-arm only; preserve all optimizer/RNG/counters, reset simulator episodes/hidden as in v1
authority.safety: KL telemetry only; unchanged finite/corruption rollback; no reward changes
authority.selection: Compare final +30 and +20 boundaries, not cherry-picked best. Half-sigma is a promising pilot only if acquisition touch coverage exceeds control by >=4/64 at both boundaries and exceeds parent at +30 by >=4/64, with finishing touch coverage no worse than control by >4/64 and finishing goals no worse by >3 at +30. Otherwise inconclusive/negative. No SSL promotion.
